intro: Answers to the questions our customers ask us most often.

onePlace.question: Can I take care of everything in one place?
onePlace.answer: Yes. With us you can get your vehicle inspection, vehicle registration, insurance and bill payments via PaySpot done – all at one address, without going from counter to counter.

appointment.question: Do I need to book an appointment?
appointment.answer: No, you don’t need an appointment – just drop by during our opening hours. If you have questions before you come, call us or message us on Viber. You can find our hours in the <hours>Opening hours</hours> section.

documents.question: Which documents do I need for vehicle registration?
documents.answer: As a rule you need the vehicle registration certificate, your ID card or, for companies, a business register extract, the compulsory insurance policy and proof of paid vehicle tax. Before you come, we are happy to tell you exactly what your vehicle requires.

duration.question: How long does the vehicle inspection take?
duration.answer: It depends on the type of vehicle. While we carry out the inspection, you can relax with a coffee in our outdoor corner.

insurance.question: Which insurance companies do you work with?
insurance.answer: We work with Serbia's leading insurers, including Dunav, DDOR, Generali, Triglav, Wiener Städtische, Sava, Uniqa, Grawe, AMS, Milenijum and Globos. We will help you choose the right policy.

fullService.question: What if I don't have time to come in person?
fullService.answer: We can pick up your vehicle at an agreed address, complete the whole procedure and bring it back to you afterwards.

more: Didn't find an answer? <contact>Contact us</contact> – we are happy to help.
